protocol.action_validity_rule: for each moving note, action output is disabled until the first KC spike of that note; starting at that spike tick, action is exactly (MBON05 maximum voltage <= the inherited fixed threshold)
protocol.validity_resets: false at the start of every note; enabled by first KC spike in that same note only
pass_criteria: at least one KC spike occurs on the naive 500-ms moving note
MBON05 has nonzero activity on the trajectory
no action is emitted at any time before the first KC spike of the current note
no action occurs in target region [0.65,0.75] or wrong region [0.15,0.25] on the naive baseline
the two fresh-state runs exactly match in KC spikes, MBON timecourse, output-validity trace, position map and actions
protocol.stop_rule: if all admission criteria pass, freeze this validity rule and stop; no Level 4 learning

scope: naive moving-note output-admission repair only; no DAN teaching or learning
